description: NaFe₂(MoO₄)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-3.00 Å. There are three inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-52°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.83 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-49°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.84 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-56°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.17 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.08 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mo and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Fe atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mo, and one Fe atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Fe atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Fe atom.
